title: Potion Math & Joining Text
hints: Use the `*` operator to multiply the incoming `$price` and `$qty` parameters, then interpolate both `$qty` and `$totalCost` into a double-quoted string.
Assign `$totalCost = $price * $qty;` and return `"{$qty} potions cost {$totalCost} coins"` without reassigning `$price` or `$qty`.
